# Strang

> A Florida-based architecture and design firm specializing in residential design, interior spaces, and landscape integration with a modernist approach.

Strang is led by Max Strang and operates offices in Miami and Winter Haven, Florida. The firm is recognized for award-winning residential architecture and design services that integrate environmental modernism principles across multiple disciplines.
